faq_heading: Homes near Langley Fundamental Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Langley Fundamental Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Langley Fundamental Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Langley Fundamental Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Langley Fundamental Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 98 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,485,000, townhomes $787,500, condos $545,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Langley Fundamental Elementary?
faq.a: For the 98 homes that sold within 1 km of Langley Fundamental Elementary, the median time on the market was 18 days and the median sale was 97.7% of list; 3% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Langley Fundamental Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Credo Christian Schools (0.3 km north-east), Murrayville Academy (0.7 km south-west) and James Hill Elementary (1.3 km south-east).

Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Langley Fundamental Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Langley Fundamental Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Langley Fundamental Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Langley Fundamental Elementary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 98 homes sold within 1 km of Langley Fundamental Elementary: 29 houses, 46 townhomes and 23 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $787,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Langley Fundamental Elementary

14 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Langley Fundamental Elementary in a straight line (5 elementary, 5 secondary, 3 other, 1 middle; 4 independent). The closest is Credo Christian Schools, 0.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is Whytecliff Agile Learning Centre-Langley, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Murrayville Academy (0.7 km); the nearest secondary school is Choices Program (1.3 km). Other elementary schools close by: Murrayville Academy (0.7 km south-west), James Hill Elementary (1.3 km south-east), Blacklock Fine Arts Elementary (2.2 km west), Uplands Elementary (2.5 km south-west), Douglas Park Community (2.5 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is James Hill Elementary, 1.3 km south-east of Langley Fundamental Elementary.
